calibration.conformal_note: split-conformal on CAL density values; finite-sample correction ceil((n+1)*alpha)/n; marginal validity only, never pointwise conditional guarantee
calibration.fit_cal_split: grouped 85/15 GroupShuffleSplit of outer-train; density fit on FIT only, thresholds on CAL only; NO refit on full outer-train (documented efficiency choice)

cv.historical_seal: C267/ID-80/ID-90 recipes extracted from Stage-16 artifacts ONLY AFTER method_freeze.json exists, into candidates_sealed.json; selection code must not reference them
cv.inner: GroupKFold(3) inside FIT-subset; hyperparameters by grouped held-out mean log-score
cv.outer: grouped 5-fold by nominal recipe group, 3 deterministic repeats = 15 outer folds

data.granularity_note: bin fractions f_j = bin_pct/100 sum to 1; bin masses b_j = CA * f_j sum back to CA
data.loader: self-contained copy of Stage-14/16 loader logic; read-only, upstream untouched

decoys.label: NON-GROUND-TRUTH conditional-discrimination diagnostic; never 'impossible mixtures'
decoys.source: deterministic +/-5pp and +/-8pp shifts of each held-out row's own observed phi, clipped to phi grid

forbidden_methods: random forest / XGBoost / LightGBM porosity regression

grids.B8_rule: simplex weights maximizing pooled inner-OOF log-score; REJECT ensemble if no OOF improvement over best constituent

grouping.key: pre-casting only: cem, water, CA, sand, SP, b1..b6
grouping.method: exact rounded key (4 decimals) then complete-linkage merge, diameter bounded by 0.1 std units; no single-linkage chaining
grouping.rule: nominal recipe groups never cross outer folds, inner folds, or FIT/CAL splits; group-excluded neighbor search everywhere

prohibitions: no LOSO campaign or LOSO gate
question: For a proposed pre-casting recipe/gradation x, can we define from observed literature data a defensible local set of hardened-porosity values phi empirically supported for recipes like x, so an inverse optimizer may choose only recipe-porosity states inside that set?

recipe_gate.calibration: grouped 5-fold CV inside FIT-subset: pooled held-out kth-NN distances; threshold = 95th percentile

primary.name: x_raw (raw bin masses; CA excluded since bins sum to CA)
primary.transform: log cem; log1p SP/sand/b1..b6; raw w/c; StandardScaler fit on FIT-subset only

sensitivity.name: x9 descriptors (Stage-15 authoritative transformed values)
sensitivity.transform: Stage-15: log cem/CA/Cu; log1p SP/sand/Aag; raw w/c/WAS/I_gap

selection_rule_lexicographic: 1. proper density quality: competitive grouped held-out CDE/log-score (B8 needs OOF gain over best member)
2. calibration: 80/90/95 HDR coverage tracks nominal; severe systematic undercoverage disqualifies
3. stability: no collapse across grouped folds or small hyperparameter perturbations
4. local evidence integrity: not routinely dominated by one study; adequate effective local N
5. conditional information gain: materially differs from global B0 where recipe info is informative
6. region measure ONLY as tie-break among statistically comparable methods
study_weight_sensitivity: row weighting primary for fitting; equal-study-weight evaluation metrics for all methods; study-weighted refit of SELECTED method only; local-neighborhood study-contribution diagnostics

support_grid.range: global observed phi rounded outward to 0.1 (dataset constant, computed once)

tuning_criterion: grouped held-out conditional mean log-score (primary); CDE-loss proxy + CRPS secondary; region width NEVER an optimization target
wording: EMPIRICAL LOCAL STATE SUPPORT only. Never attainable/achievable/physically feasible. HDR = smallest high-density probability region under the estimated conditional density; disconnected sets preserved.
